verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents a substantial programmatic surface: the bq CLI for creating datasets, loading data and querying; the Storage Write API (gRPC/REST); SDKs including a Rust preview; ODBC/JDBC drivers that let you 'use BigQuery features with your preferred tooling'; and SQL DML/procedural statements. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that every UI capability is reachable programmatically, and console-centric features such as data canvas, conversational analytics, data insights and notebooks have no documented API equivalents here. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of UI-only features (data canvas, conversational analytics, data insights, notebooks), and independent confirmation of parity.
